input.summary: Limit the no-consent affiliate/successor exception to Customer and bar Kubient from assigning to a Customer competitor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have made the no-consent affiliate and successor carve-out available to Customer only, so Kubient's assignments continue to require our consent (not unreasonably withheld), and added a bar on assignment to a Customer competitor.

ops.oldText: either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction.
ops.newText: Customer may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of Customer's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction, and Kubient may not assign this Agreement to any competitor of Customer.
